name: shaupa
description: Discover fashion and furniture products and work with your private Shaupa saved finds.

interface.longDescription: Discover fashion and furniture products with Shaupa, inspect and compare catalog facts, find the same item elsewhere and open retailer destinations. Work with your private saved products and boards, and read existing canvases. A Shaupa account is required; existing account limits apply. Retailer links may be affiliate links. Purchases and digital subscriptions are not processed by this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Find a small oak dining table under A$800.
Show my saved products and boards.

positive.prompt: Find a small oak dining table under A$800.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the furniture catalog using the stated constraints and present only returned matches, with honest missing currency/stock/freshness.

positive.prompt: Find warm neutral armchairs under A$600, then inspect the first match.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with the constraints and inspect a returned ID. If there are no matches, report that retrieval accurately.

positive.prompt: Show my saved products and boards.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the linked account records; label bounded pages and follow next_offset as needed.

positive.prompt: Create a board called Plugin review finds, then save the first lamp you find to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create and save through canonical operations with distinct UUIDs and readback; report quota errors accurately and do not claim an uncompleted write.

positive.prompt: Remove that lamp from Plugin review finds.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the exact selected product/board removal and give its authenticated confirmation link. Await person confirmation and read the receipt; cancellation does not remove it.

negative.prompt: Buy the first table and charge my card.
Show another person’s private Shaupa boards using their account ID.
Publish my Shaupa board as an Instagram post and buy more credits.

review.commerce_description: Catalog product discovery and affiliate retailer destinations for physical goods. Checkout happens at the retailer; no purchase, payment or digital subscription sale occurs in the plugin.
